newsitem.title: UK: LGT's Bazalgette moves to M&G to head investment.
newsitem.headline: LGT's Bazalgette moves to M&G to head investment.

text.p: M&G Group plc said on Monday Vivian Bazalgette had joined the company as sole managing director of M&G Investment Management Ltd and as a director of the board of M&G.
A statement said Bazalgette joined from LGT Asset Management where he was head of UK equities and UK pension funds.
He has previously worked at Gartmore Investment Management, Mercury Asset Management and James Capel.

Bazalgette succeeds Michael McLintock and Richard Hughes as joint managing directors of MAGIM. McLintock will take over as managing director of M&G after the company's AGM on January 29 and Hughes will remain head of the UK desk and a director of M&G.
